steps.label: rename-parent
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE RenameParent(id INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY(id)

steps.label: rename-child
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE RenameChild(id INT64 NOT NULL,parent INT64,CONSTRAINT FK FOREIGN KEY(parent) REFERENCES RenameParent(id)) PRIMARY KEY(id)

steps.label: add-synonym
steps.sql: ALTER TABLE RenameParent ADD SYNONYM ParentAlias

steps.label: synonym-metadata
steps.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME,SYNONYM FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME='RenameParent'
